name: mini-hud
description: A minimal HUD in the prompt footer: model, effort, folder and git branch, context bar, and subscription usage (5-hour and weekly), rotating, side by side or one alone.

showModel.title: Show the model
showModel.description: The model in use, right after the permission mode.

showEffort.title: Show the effort
showEffort.description: The reasoning effort level (low, medium, high, xhigh, max).

showGit.title: Show folder and branch
showGit.description: The folder you work in and, in a git repository, its branch (with * when there are uncommitted changes).

showContext.title: Show the context
showContext.description: A bar and the % of context used, measured against the autocompact window.

showUsage.title: Show subscription usage
showUsage.description: The 5-hour and weekly windows at the bottom right.

display.title: What the usage meter shows
display.description: rotate: one window at a time, alternating. both: 5-hour and weekly side by side. session: only the 5-hour window. week: only the weekly window.

rotateSeconds.title: Seconds per window
rotateSeconds.description: How long each window shows before switching. Only used when display is rotate.

hideCycleHint.title: Hide "(shift+tab to cycle)"
hideCycleHint.description: Leaves more room for the meter.

hideInterruptHint.title: Hide "esc to interrupt"
hideInterruptHint.description: Leaves more room for the meter while Claude works.
